messages:
Clara (Docs): quick sync — finalizing release-note + changelog for embed routing change. short 'what changed', one-line migration tip, and SDK examples. PR will be small.
Ben (Product): keep it concise: default = latency-first; deterministic opt-in; mention transient ordering quirk during cache warmup. no data loss.
Maya (SDK): prepping JS + Python snippets. confirm flag name and values?
Ethan (Eng): use `route_hint` with `latency`/`deterministic`. model alias renamed to `embed-ll-1` — redirects active but recommend switching.
Clara (Docs): draft migration: "If deterministic token ordering is required, set `route_hint: \"deterministic\"` (may slightly increase latency)."
Ben (Product): good. add known-issue: "First requests after cache warmup can show minor token-order differences; KB placeholder: https://kb.redwood.ai/embed-routing-ordering"
Maya (SDK): will mirror the migration tip and add a commented guard in examples. snippets will be single-block for mobile.
preview-bot: Preview available: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-9999 :white_check_mark:
Clara (Docs): checklist before merge: 1) SDK snippets (Maya) 2) KB page (Ethan) 3) preview mobile check (Ben) 4) TOC anchor + known-issues (Clara). aiming to publish Friday AM.
Ben (Product): thanks team — i'll ping support and marketing once live. :tada:
